sourceFile: 45.L20S15-07 Report Test using Primer AS 8100  and lumix 840 Clean SMG and CMG date 13.10.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test evidence but the changed-factor and measurement groupings are materially unreliable.
issues: Changed factor conflates cleaning agents, joint types, and processes.
Normal baseline is not mapped per outcome or test round.
Second sheet shake-well condition is not preserved.
Decap and tension measurements are mis-extracted from headers.
Measurement citations point to headers instead of data rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Is normal production the intended baseline for all outcomes?
Should alcohol be treated as a control condition or a tested cleaning agent?
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as cleaning condition: normal versus Primer AS8100, Lumix 840, and possibly alcohol.
Keep sheet/test round, date, line, process, and joint type as subgroup keys.
Rebuild vision and decap results from actual data rows by process and cleaning condition.
Rebuild tension results by type test rows, not sample columns.
Cite section rows plus each supporting data row used for every subresult.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient for final evidence because key measurement data rows are missing or miscited.
